meaning: The state of the five hundred pages on the production origin after the call to action work, the audits and the four defects they found. Every figure was read from https://livdar.com or from a Google served file, not from this repository.

allFiveHundred.method: scripts/atlas/verify-live.mjs, one request per published URL, the served HTML compared against the page model field by field
checked: html lang equals the page language
every hreflang the model declares including x-default
a tool present exactly where the model declares one
allFiveHundred.note: Node's built in fetch ignores HTTPS_PROXY unless NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 is set. Without it every request returns 403 from the egress proxy: five hundred identical failures that look exactly like a site that is down.

entity.foundAndFixed: twenty one meta descriptions in five languages that took the country as an argument and never used it

language.note: two corrections took it from four hundred false positives to zero: a fixture is a leak only where that language's pack would produce something different, and the marker exclusions are read from each language's own pack file one column at a time

staticReasons.city-comparison: declares two cities as its inputs and the only price data that exists is national
staticReasons.relocation-budget: composes three other tools and needs a city level rent that is not published

tools.verifiedInBrowser: 10 of 10 at 390 by 844: renders, output changes when a control changes, controls at least 44 pixels tall with a 16 pixel font, every control labelled, no horizontal overflow, tool_view then tool_start then tool_complete, no reader input in any event

defectsFound.what: five hundred pages declared an x-default and none carried it
defectsFound.why: the hreflang map the language switcher needs drops x-default, correctly, and the route passed that same map to the metadata builder
defectsFound.hidden: cohort QA has an x-default check and it passes, because it reads the page model rather than the served HTML

defectsFound.what: the moving cost calculator rendered three working selects above an output that never appeared
defectsFound.why: the implementation takes moveSize and returns a range and three scenarios; the component sent size and looked for a total, and reported unknown move size: undefined to nobody

defectsFound.what: six sizes and five transports were English on every page
defectsFound.why: the labels live inside the implementation and a select is not in the page model, so the language audit could not see it

defectsFound.what: twenty one meta descriptions never named their country
defectsFound.why: the salary descriptions in Italian, Polish, Spanish, Dutch and Portuguese say there rather than the name, while English, German, French and Japanese name it
harmless while every page was server rendered prose, and not harmless once sixty two tool pages carried a calculator that only exists after the bundle loads

indexability.robotsTxt: Allow /, Disallow /api/ only, 74 sitemaps listed including all 58 Atlas ones

xDefault.rule: present exactly where the cluster has an English page and pointing at it; cohort-pages.mjs refuses to nominate an arbitrary language otherwise, because x-default is optional and a wrong one sends a reader to a language nobody chose

observability.window: the last twenty four hours on the production deployment
observability.note: the 502s and ChunkLoadErrors seen during the earlier browser sweep did not appear here, which is where a Vercel generated 502 would appear. Each affected page rendered perfectly when re-opened alone and each chunk answered 200 on retest, so it reads as this container's egress under sixty five concurrent browser sessions rather than the origin.

missing: the service account added as a user of the property
searchConsole.whyNotDoneHere: no service account key exists in this project and Search Console asked this container to sign in

missing: five event names in the GA4 event tag trigger
nine data layer variables and nine parameter rows
tagManagerChanges.whyNotDoneHere: Tag Manager redirected this container to the Google sign in page

ga4CustomDimensions.whyNotDoneHere: Analytics redirected this container to the Google sign in page

missing: the Clarity project id, then NEXT_PUBLIC_CLARITY_ID in Vercel
clarity.whyNotDoneHere: Clarity asked this container to sign in, so there is no id to set. A guess would be worse than empty: the loader is gated on the value, so empty renders no script and wrong renders a broken tag on all five hundred pages

notConnected.authenticationTest: Search Console, Tag Manager, Analytics and Clarity were each opened at a URL that only renders for a signed in account. All four returned a sign in form. Ahrefs, which can hold a Search Console connection, has no GSC data for the Livdar project either.

search.indexedRate: stays unknown: Search Analytics reports impressions and not index state, and the Pages report is a separate import

behaviour.blockedBy: GA4_PROPERTY_ID and a service account with Viewer on the property

measurementPipeline.rule: an absent number is unknown and never zero, in both halves
